episode_summary: In this episode, Valerie Fitzgerald shares her journey from a single mother with no resources to a top luxury real estate agent in Los Angeles. She discusses the importance of embracing fear, leveraging open houses, and using AI to build authority in the competitive luxury market. Valerie's story is a testament to the power of persistence, creativity, and innovation in achieving success.
